name: SDR Passive Listening
description: Software Defined Radio allows capture and analysis of arbitrary RF signals across a wide frequency range. In physical red teaming, SDR is primarily a reconnaissance and analysis tool — identifying unknown wireless systems, analyzing proprietary protocols, and supporting replay attack development against custom or unusual systems. SDR tools are not commonly deployed in standard engagements but are invaluable when encountering non-standard access control or alarm systems.

blue.det: SDR hardware visible near facility; RF monitoring may detect wide-band scanning activity; difficult to detect passive listening.
blue.cm: Encrypt all RF communications where possible; use frequency hopping; TEMPEST shielding for sensitive areas; RF monitoring for unusual signal activity near facility.
